description.zh: bm 词：搜 Chrome 和 Edge 的书签（含账户书签），支持拼音，Enter 打开
description.en: bm words: searches Chrome and Edge bookmarks, account ones too, by pinyin as well; Enter opens

description.zh: 搜 Chrome / Edge 的书签（含账户书签），可用拼音
description.en: Search Chrome / Edge bookmarks, account ones too, pinyin works

hint.zh: 书签的名字、文件夹或网址里的词；名字和文件夹是汉字的话也可以打拼音
hint.en: words of a bookmark's name, folder or address; pinyin for Chinese names and folders too

ai.description: Search the user's Chrome and Edge bookmarks (the local list and the signed-in account's) by words in the title or URL; each item has the title, the folder and the URL (open.url).

hint.zh: Chromium 系浏览器的 Bookmarks 文件（Brave、Vivaldi…），和 Chrome、Edge 的一起搜
hint.en: A Chromium browser's Bookmarks file (Brave, Vivaldi …), searched with Chrome's and Edge's
